key_points: Alibaba's $10.2B equity raise (710M shares at a discount) signals heavy AI capex needs and introduces meaningful shareholder dilution, pressuring near-term valuation.

Anthropic's allegations that Alibaba and DeepSeek trained on Claude data, plus US spy agency claims over AI data theft, create a legal and geopolitical overhang that could escalate into sanctions or restrictions.
Market skepticism around Alibaba's AI robotics push and broader questions about whether AI infrastructure spending will translate to cash flow quickly enough weigh on sentiment.
Bernstein lowered its price target on BABA, reinforcing the bearish narrative around the AI bet.

Partial offsets exist — CEO share accumulation, Winton Group establishing a position, and some sell-side views citing 55% undervaluation — but these are secondary to the dilution and legal risks in the near term.
